title: Linting, Formatting, and Code Quality Tools
subtopics: Linting, Formatting, and Code Quality Tools
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose and main behavior of linting, formatting, and code quality tools.
Apply linting, formatting, and code quality tools in a small Python example or interpret a representative result.
Identify one limitation, edge case, compatibility concern, or failure mode relevant to the topic.

content.intro: This lesson introduces linting, formatting, and code quality tools as part of testing, debugging, and code quality. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: Reliable software expects mistakes and failures. Reproduce the smallest failing case, assert the intended behavior, and fix the cause rather than hiding the symptom.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Reliable software expects mistakes and failures. Reproduce the smallest failing case, assert the intended behavior, and fix the cause rather than hiding the symptom.
